messages:
Priya (CS): Morning — quick async standup for AcmeNudge renewal + embed throttling. What I did / Blockers / Today

Priya (CS): Yesterday: ran audit of the 3 flagged customers, confirmed AcmeNudge saw spike in failed webhook retries (100s). Opened support ticket with eng.
Priya (CS): Blocker: renewal exec wants ETA on fix and whether it affects their SLA. I don’t have a clear timeline to give.
Priya (CS): Today: need a short explainer for execs + mitigation steps we can offer (rate limits, backoff config, temporary routing to dedicated).

Tom (Eng): thanks Priya. I dug into the retry logs — looks like our inbound webhook worker is hitting a burst of long-tail latencies when embedding pipeline queues up.
Tom (Eng): root cause suspicion: KV cache thrash on the small GPU pool coupled with high concurrent prefix requests.

Eli (SRE): saw the same in infra metrics. GPU pool memory pressure spikes around 06:00–08:00 UTC for that customer workspace. Possible autoscaler mis-tuning + sticky routing.

Maya (Solutions): quick question — can we offer AcmeNudge a short-term config change they can apply to reduce retries (client-side) while we patch? e.g., increase backoff base to 2s and jitter?

Tom (Eng): yes, that’d help immediately. Also we can temporarily route their traffic to a warm dedicated node group — low-risk rollback. Would need a manual bump from infra.

Priya (CS): Jess, do we want to propose the routing + client config to the customer first or give the exec ETA?

Jess (CS Manager): propose both. Tell exec: mitigation available now (client backoff + temporary routing). ETA for more permanent fix: ~24–48h for config + canary. Keep it conservative. :thumbsup:

Tom (Eng): action items for eng: 1) instrument KV cache eviction logs for that workspace (priority) 2) add autoscaler tweak to tolerate short bursts 3) prepare migration playbook for routing. I can take 1+3, Eli can take 2.

Eli (SRE): taking autoscaler tweak. I’ll test on staging and post results here.

Priya (CS): Thanks — please ping me when you have the staging result so I can tell AcmeNudge support team. Also need a one-paragraph explainer I can send to execs.

Tom (Eng): drafting explainer now — will post a short blurb in ~45m.

deploy-bot: deployment event: canary/kv-cache-logging started on staging at 2026-03-17T08:05:31Z — build 2026.03.17-76

Maya (Solutions): small note — if routing is manual it should include a rate-limit cap so the dedicated nodes don't get overwhelmed. Recommend setting 30% throttle initially.

Tom (Eng): good call. adding throttle step to playbook.

Priya (CS): perfect. Final asks from me: 1) explainer blurb 2) confirmation of staging autoscaler test 3) a short rollback checklist. If we get those in next 6–12h we can brief execs and propose the change for tonight’s window.

Jess (CS Manager): yep — aiming to brief execs EOD. Thanks everyone.

Tom (Eng): will update thread with the blurb.

Eli (SRE): will post autoscaler test results in here once I finish — ETA 2h.

Priya (CS): awesome. tagging @Jess for tracking and @Maya for the customer config snippet follow-up.

Maya (Solutions): I’ll DM the client-friendly backoff examples and paste a short snippet here for Priya to forward.

Priya (CS): thanks all — I’ll follow up after the staging validation. :pray:
